summary: P4 has a live private OpenClaw sandbox running from the reviewed script after a Docker Compose v5.1.3 flag correction. Runtime health, readiness, loopback-only exposure, and native exec approval policy are proven. The dry run found and corrected a source .env injection risk with an env_file reset override, and the provider preflight pinned the official linux/amd64 image digest. P4 still cannot pass because hosted model usability is blocked: openai-codex auth is missing and no OPENAI_API_KEY, P4_OPENAI_CODEX_API_KEY, or OPENROUTER_API_KEY is present in the inspected environment.

mechanical_validation.output_summary: Governance validator passed with required files, registers, schemas, fixtures, phase gates, agent entrypoints, evidence contracts, access contract, gate review contract, gate action contract, and intervention balance contract.

criteria_results.assessment: The sandbox is live and healthy, healthz and readyz pass, and ss shows only 127.0.0.1 listeners on 18789 and 18790 with no broad 0.0.0.0, [::], or wildcard listener on those ports.

The preflight confirmed the official image and native model-auth command path. Live model validation still fails because openai-codex auth is missing, models status exits 1, and the inspected environment has no OPENAI_API_KEY, P4_OPENAI_CODEX_API_KEY, or OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

The protected-boundary script was proven to fail closed without P4_APPROVED, and the live sandbox native approvals/exec-policy commands now show an approvals file with security=full, ask=always, askFallback=deny and no allowlist entries.

The only production mutation was the approved P4 private sandbox apply. It used the isolated state root, pinned image digest, loopback ports, and native approval policy; no public admin surface or non-sandbox production target was mutated.

anti_drift_results.assessment: The dry-run rendered local-only published ports, and the live runtime has only 127.0.0.1 listeners on 18789 and 18790 with no broad listener match.

anti_drift_results.requirement: no runtime config mutation without approval
anti_drift_results.assessment: The packet explicitly marks runtime config, Docker, network, secrets, and auth as protected boundaries. The apply was executed only after Ryan delegated approval for this P4 boundary, and the live runtime now has ask=always approval policy.
The proposed deployment uses OpenClaw Docker Compose only and the reviewed script does not add cron, a separate queue, or a second scheduler/control plane.

runtime_enforcement.assessment: The sandbox is live and OpenClaw native exec approvals are enforced with security=full, ask=always, askFallback=deny, and no allowlist entries. Model auth remains blocked separately.

blocking_findings: Hosted model usability is blocked because openai-codex auth is missing and no usable model API key is present in the inspected environment.
